case.description: Mild chest tightness with occasional dizziness and 2‑day headache, ambiguous urgency
turns: Doctor sahab, mujhe chest me thoda tightness feel ho raha hai, kabhi kabhi dizziness hoti hai, aur do din se headache hai.
Yeh tightness bahut zyada nahi hai, sirf halki si, aur dizziness kabhi kabhi hoti hai, koi bahut tej pain nahi.
